info.title: FE-06 Loyalty & Promotion API
info.description: Approved technical contract (2026-10-24, Đặng Thị Khương); not yet implemented. Shared verified bearer identity plus current local capability and ownership required (V1 requires no MFA, per 001). The separate React + Vite frontend uses these REST operations with the same bearer; source-owned checkout integration is in interfaces.md. No public reserve/settle/earn/restore endpoints. All protected responses no-store.

get.description: Only currently effective programs. Cards do not reserve quota or prove checkout eligibility.
Public effective program details; inactive saved voucher information is returned by own wallet, not treated as redeemable.

post.description: PAUSED to ENABLED on same program and code. Preserve used/held quota, history, existing accepted terms and validity dates. New transactions still require current conditions. Stale version or wrong state conflicts; same committed command replays.

PositiveId.description: Signed BIGINT positive decimal string; validate <=9223372036854775807.

Version.description: Nonnegative BIGINT version; enforce exact range.

NonnegativeAmount.description: Exact integer VND or points, DECIMAL(19,0), no float.

Quota.description: Positive signed BIGINT; exact upper bound enforced.

Percentage.description: Decimal percent string, strictly >0 and <=100; at most 6 fractional digits.

Code.description: Trim ends; Locale.ROOT uppercase comparison; reject control characters; never reuse.

ProductTargets.description: At least one product/variant set, no branch restriction.

WorkshopTargets.description: Optional dimensions narrow package scope; booking window separate from workshop dates.

allowPoints.description: Automatic discounts always allow points (decided 2026-10-26); may be omitted, false is rejected with VALIDATION_ERROR.

CreateProgram.description: startAt<endAt; source target validation required. Voucher quota required; auto has no code/quota.

ProgramUpdate.description: PATCH merges supplied allowed fields into a full new valid revision. Cannot change code/scope/kind. Targets must match original scope; auto rejects quotas and allowPoints=false (auto always allows points).

ProgramUsage.description: Current voucher usage: consumedCount and committedDiscountAmount exclude previews, holds and validly cancelled workshop bookings whose cancellation outcome has been applied. Preserve original consume/restore history. Program expiry or pause does not remove uncancelled settled usage. Repeated cancellation never subtracts twice.

AutoUsage.description: Only settled automatic discount transactions count; previews and held-only acceptances are excluded.

availability.description: NO_PUBLIC_TARGET: product program whose targets are currently all hidden, unpublished or deleted (shown as "Hiện không có sản phẩm áp dụng").

fieldErrors.description: Common error envelope (common.ErrorResponse): one entry per invalid field; omitted when empty.

Unauthorized.description: Invalid missing expired or revoked credentials

Conflict.description: Stale version duplicate code quota conflict or changed idempotent payload

DependencyUnavailable.description: Required dependency unavailable or retryable lock contention
